licenseEvidence.CMakeLists: contains a Google LLC BSD-3-Clause notice

decisionBoundary: The exact pinned Ruby inputs and generated output are reproducible. Official primary licensing materials provide general project/repository rules but do not connect these exact Ruby inputs to a governing license. Keep WebGPU applicability UNKNOWN; no legal conclusion, complete notice, source/relink closure or release qualification is established.

externalLicenseEvidence.title: GPU for the Web repository license
externalLicenseEvidence.finding: The official repository distinguishes document licensing from software licensing and says software contributions use the GPU for the Web 3-Clause BSD License.
externalLicenseEvidence.scopeLimit: This does not establish that the exact pinned WebKit Ruby generator inputs are contributions covered by that repository license.

externalLicenseEvidence.title: WebKit licensing documentation
externalLicenseEvidence.finding: The official guide says new WebKit code uses 2-Clause BSD and moved code keeps its original license.
externalLicenseEvidence.scopeLimit: The pinned Ruby files have no explicit license headers and this guide does not identify their origin or license.

externalLicenseEvidence.title: WebKit licensing overview
